name: Marc Rohde
title: Hi! I'm Marc Rohde
tagline: Technologist, Business Executive, Busy Parent, Amateur Outdoorsman

photo.alt: Black and white portrait of Marc Rohde

bio: I started my professional career in 1996 and have had the opportunity to work on some really interesting projects over the years.

As a technologist I'm a jack of many trades and a master of none -- I'm always learning. I have been a network administrator and architect, web developer and architect, and have an extensive background in ERP systems.
As a leader, I have a passion for solving big problems and coaching an engaged team.

In the past, I had a number of projects underway and as time has become more precious this page has become a directory of my social profiles and some utilities that I use frequently. Hopefully, I will soon have time to continue to maintain this site and return to my passion projects.

learning.heading: What am I trying to master now?
